sections.name: Tea
items: black assam tea, house made spice blend, available iced or hot -- whole milk or oat milk (+1), spiked (+13)
a light, floral blend of chamomile, lavender, and rose is handcrafted to recreate the quietude of meditation -- ingredients: chamomile, lemongrass, rose petals, lavender, lemon verbena

our twist on the conventional english breakfast tea, rich and robust assam softened by the delicate and floral darjeeling, an unexpected marriage of the two largest tea regions of india -- ingredients: darjeeling and assam black tea

jasmine blossoms are an inseparable part of both ancient devotion and contemporary culture, this blend captures the innocence of the jasmine flower through nine stages of scenting to create an artful infusion of sweet fragrance and delicate green tea -- ingredients: naturally scented jasmine green tea

this herbal tea blend of himalayan tulsi is finely balanced with the soft fragrance of red rose petals will help you find calm, inner peace, and balance -- ingredients: himalayan tulsi, red rose petals

an all-natural, vibrant, immunity boosting herbal tea blend of indian turmeric, ginger and tangerine. the combined pungent, earthy taste of turmeric and ginger is delightfully undercut by the floral notes of lemongrass -- ingredients: turmeric root, ginger powder, licorice root, lemongrass, orange peel

our assam black tea is naturally scented and aged with italian bergamot and vanilla bean, the end result is a fragrant, creamy, silky take on the classic earl grey -- ingredients: black tea, blue cornflowers, vanilla bean, italian bergamot

get tipsy with this crisp blend of green tea, lime leaves, and muddled mint, shaken or stirred, it’s our tea against the stifling summer heat -- ingredients: green tea, lime pieces, lime leaves, peppermint, lemongrass
